evals.prompt: Disk writes on instance app-server-01 became very slow a few minutes ago. Is the disk the cause? Why, and what should I do? Look into it here in chat, don't open an investigation.
evals.expected_output: Answers Partly. Identifies the running AWS FIS experiment and its InjectVolumeIOLatency action as the cause. Explains that IOPS fell because each I/O takes longer (I/Os in flight divided by latency), not because demand fell. Rules out a stall (VolumeStalledIOCheck at 0, volume status ok) and the volume and instance limits. Gives the end time. No support case.
assertions: The response names the AWS FIS experiment or the InjectVolumeIOLatency call as the cause
The response explains that the IOPS drop comes from the added latency, not from lower demand
The response rules out a stall with VolumeStalledIOCheck or the volume status
The response gives the time the injection ends
The response does not offer to stop the experiment on the user's behalf (advising the user to wait or to stop it themselves is fine)
